name: Josefina Bustamante
bio: Josefina is an iOS software engineer. She has been developing iOS stuff for more than 7 years, although she never gets tired of learning. Since the pandemic, she jumped into the adventure of building her startup to make an impact in education, Bel Community. At Bel she is co-founder, developer, PO and leads the tech team. She is also co-founder of the largest iOS conference in LATAM, BA:Swiftable =)
